name: Simón Díaz
scope: Dedicated Simón audit using his preserved dossier, actual shared-engine fights and this agent's own native preview tab. Only this report and tests/character-audits/simon.test.ts were written in the repository. No server, runtime edits, commits, child agents or new broad research.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: Simón Narciso Díaz Márquez, portrayed in his older Tío Simón years as a Venezuelan musician, composer, humorist and presenter. These identifications are preserved dossier evidence, not newly researched claims.
identityAndPortrayal.visualMatch: The inspected sprites retain his round smiling clean-shaven face, age lines, broad light llanero hat, cream liqui-liqui and brown shoes. The preserved official photograph inspected locally shows the same hat, cream outfit and smile, and also a cuatro. Hair and baldness are partly hidden by the sprite's hat, so the full scalp trait cannot be assessed.
identityAndPortrayal.fictionalAdaptation: Acorde llanero and the three musical trajectories fit the documented musician portrayal. Primer acorde, Contrapunteo and Tonada de la arena are fictional fighting adaptations.
identityAndPortrayal.audioLimit: The dossier identifies an original sung/recited copla clip and explicitly qualifies automatic ASR attribution. This audit did not listen to it or verify audiovisual synchronization.

movementAndStance.movement: Starting x540, 24 right inputs reach630.7859606341043; 24 subsequent left inputs reach547.613793025476. Facing follows the inputs. Both player sides reproduce the same result.
movementAndStance.jump: The first jump reaches y454.6 after10 calls. A second jump is accepted and a third rejected; landing restores grounded=true, y554 and jumps0 on both sides.
movementAndStance.stance: Ready and guard use frame1. Production drawSprite was inspected for all eight frames in both facings: relaxed0, guard1, run2/3, tucked jump4, punch5, high kick6 and recoil7. The corrected punch/high-kick order is coherent. Complete heads, hands, shoes and silhouettes remained visible in the final contact sheet.

special.name: Acorde llanero
special.distinctBehavior: Three simultaneous notes form a fan with horizontal speed8 and vertical speeds-3.2,0,3.2. The upward note actually catches a jumping target. Simón remains stationary at the tested280-pixel gap.
special.idle: At gap280, both sides emit all three notes at call12. One center note hits at call35 for8.8065 HP against Javier's1.03 armor, leaving HP91.1935 and one attacker hit. No projectiles remain after170 calls.
special.forwardGuard: Grounded guard facing the incoming notes blocks the center note on both sides, preserving HP100 with one block effect and zero attacker hits. Defender energy finishes70.84 after170 calls of held guard; attacker energy immediately after activation is75.
special.backwardGuard: Holding block while moving away faces the defender in the wrong direction. Both sides take one hit at call43, retain HP91.1935, and produce no block effect.
special.airCoverage: With jump and special requested together at gap280, the upward note hits at call35 when the defender's feet are y433.6 and impact y402.2; the center note hits at call57 at y479. Both sides finish HP82.387 with two hits. Delaying special10 calls still yields two hits; delaying20 yields one center-note hit and HP91.1935.
special.energyGate: Energy24 rejects special on both sides. Energy100 spends25 before emission and any hit reward.
special.rangeInterpretation: Projectile lifetime controls actual reach;500 is the nominal technique range used by CPU selection. Notes separate vertically, and shared hit invulnerability can prevent simultaneous notes all damaging one target. Close collision can consume a projectile within its emission step, so surviving IDs undercount notes at gaps25/80. The gap25 probe also separates initially overlapping players. These observations did not establish a Simón-specific combat bug.

attacksAndCombos.light: Both sides hit once at gap80 for6.8495 damage and outward knockback. Facing guard prevents HP loss.
attacksAndCombos.heavy: Both sides hit once at gap80 for12.7205 damage and outward knockback. Facing guard prevents HP loss.
attacksAndCombos.baseCombo: Primer acorde (L→H) connects both strikes using approach inputs on both sides, leaving target HP77.34 after68 calls, with heavy bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.advancedCombo: Contrapunteo (L→L→H) connects all three strikes using approach inputs on both sides, leaving target HP66.3705 after115 calls, with heavy bonus7. At zero wins the same three inputs remain Primer acorde with bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.recognitionLimit: Combo recognition uses input history, so separate out-of-range light setup probes can still name and buff heavy. The connected-combo checks independently confirm every strike lands.
attacksAndCombos.definitive: Tonada de la arena requires three wins and75 energy. At gap200 and startup9 it hits once on both sides for39.758 damage, leaving Javier HP60.242: (28*0.95+12)*1.03. Zero/two wins and three wins with74 energy reject activation. This is the shared close-range super, not a distinct musical projectile.

cpuFight.method: Complete the510-tick shared intro, hold Simón idle180 calls to exercise CPU offense, then send real approach/guard/jump and light/heavy/special/super inputs. Run the full bout twice and compare complete final state.
cpuFight.limitation: Special starts but does not hit during this CPU bout. Dedicated idle, guard and air-coverage fights separately verify its collisions. This controller is an exercised fight, not a balance benchmark.

introAndSelection.name: Inclinación de sombrero
introAndSelection.actualAppChecks: Selected Simón through the lobby's ordinary character button and inspected his ready portrait. Selection portrait data reached progress1 and frame1.
introAndSelection.controlledChecks: Used production loadSprite, drawSprite and drawPresentation in an ephemeral canvas in this agent's own native tab. Inspected all eight combat sprites in both facings and intro/selection at progress0/.5/1 in each facing. No repository visual harness was written.
introAndSelection.observation: Start/end samples hold guard frame1. Midpoint switches to relaxed frame0 with a small head/hat inclination and arm/body gesture, plus subdued hat accents. Mirroring remains coherent. No missing hand, head or foot was observed in the final nonoverlapping contact sheet. A literal hand-to-brim gesture was not shown in the sampled midpoint.
introAndSelection.oneShot: selectionProgress clamps to1 at2800ms and stays1 at5600ms. Portrait stops requesting animation frames at1. Engine intro rejects motion and attacks until the full510-tick timeline completes.
introAndSelection.transientFailure: Dynamic module imports later failed even while direct fetch returned200. Reloading this agent's own tab restored production imports. No server was started. An earlier contact sheet overlapped wide poses; the saved final sheet uses16 separate slots and is complete.
introAndSelection.excludedEvidence: A match-start attempt clicked selection and start inside the same JavaScript turn before React applied the new selection. Its screenshot showed Vicente/Javier, so it is excluded as evidence for Simón's actual cinematic. Simón's production intro was inspected through the controlled samples instead.
introAndSelection.limitations: Representative static frames were inspected, not every interpolation frame, a complete Simón browser cinematic or audio playback. The full CPU bout was run in the shared engine. The native tab was closed after screenshots were saved and inspected.

findings.title: The musical special has no illustrated cuatro or strumming pose
findings.evidence: All eight inspected combat sprites have empty hands. src/game/renderer.ts maps special to the ordinary punch frame5 after startup and has no cuatro-specific pose branch. The preserved official photograph includes the instrument, and the dossier's suggested Acorde llanero explicitly proposes retaining it in hand.
findings.impact: Musical projectiles and air coverage function correctly. The current visual adaptation presents the move as a punch without an instrument. This is a portrayal gap against a suggested move; gameplay is not blocked and no collision defect or mandatory runtime requirement is asserted.
findings.recommendation: If the dossier's held-cuatro move is adopted as the presentation target, provide an instrument/strumming special pose that retains the current three trajectories.

recommendation: Keep the tested combat behavior. Treat the missing instrument as a small presentation refinement; no reproducible Simón-specific engine bug was found.
